Mary

messages.author: bc810b1d0900407f
messages.subject: Re: Factor correlation parameter estimates
parts:
Hi,

Add  standardized = TRUE to the call of summary(). The column `std.all` for factor covariances are factor correlations.

``` r
library(lavaan)
#> This is lavaan 0.6-17
#> lavaan is FREE software! Please report any bugs.
```

``` r
HS.model <- ' visual  =~ x1 + x2 + x3
              textual =~ x4 + x5 + x6
              speed   =~ x7 + x8 + x9 '

fit <- cfa(HS.model, data = HolzingerSwineford1939)
summary(fit, standardized = TRUE)
#> lavaan 0.6.17 ended normally after 35 iterations
#>
#>   Estimator                                         ML
#>   Optimization method                           NLMINB

This only works for an ordinary CFA. Mary used the sem function to fit the model. It could be a CFA, but it doesn't have to be.

library(lavaan)

HS.model <- ' visual  =~ x1 + x2 + x3
              textual =~ x4 + x5 + x6
              speed   =~ x7 + x8 + x9 '

fit <- cfa(HS.model, data = HolzingerSwineford1939)
summary(fit, standardized = TRUE)
lavInspect(fit, "cor.lv")

HS.model <- ' visual  =~ x1 + x2 + x3
              textual =~ x4 + x5 + x6
              speed   =~ x7 + x8 + x9
visual ~ textual + speed

'

fit <- cfa(HS.model, data = HolzingerSwineford1939)
summary(fit, standardized = TRUE)
lavInspect(fit, "cor.lv")
